book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Jisas i vɨva mbwa na i tabo na waen
Mbaŋa mbaŋaiwo e ghereiye, thɨ vakatha ghe ghathaga regha, e ghemba regha idae Kena Galili e tɨne. Jisas tɨnae va ina gheko,
na Jisas na gharaghambu vambe ghanjikula nava e thagako iyako rɨghe.
Mbaŋa waen vama i ko, Jisas tɨnae i dagewe amalaghɨniye iŋa, “Waen kaero i ko weŋgi.”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Nava, buda kaiwae len renuwaŋa ina e ghino? Wo mbaŋa ya vakatha bigi ŋgora iyako mamba i mena.”
Tɨnae i dage weŋgiya rakakaiwo iŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga iŋa weŋga hu vakatha ŋgoreiye.”

Mbwa varivariye, thɨ vakathaŋgi e varɨ, vwarawona, va thɨ bigiraweŋgi. Thiyako thɨ vakaiwoŋaŋgi kaiwae thɨ ghambugha Jiu lenji kururu ghakamwathɨ. Vwarara mbwako e tɨneko le ghanaghanagha mbwata i wo vwaramonyi vwaraiwo o vwarato.
Jisas i dage weŋgiya rakakaiwoma iŋa, “Hu gudumbana mbwa e mbwake varivariye.” Thɨ gudu vanjaraŋgi moli.
Amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Mbaŋake iyake hu guda vavana e mbwana variye na hu giyawe amalako iya i ndeviva e thagako.” Thɨ vakatha ŋgoreiye,
na amalako iyako i mando mbwako iyama me vɨvɨna waenɨko. Ma i ghareghare waenɨke iyake aŋga me mena, ko iyemaeŋge rakakaiwoma iya methɨ guduma thɨ ghareghare. Iyake kaiwae i kulawe ragheghe ghɨmoruma

na iŋa, “Thaga tanuwagae me giyakaiya waen thovuye, na mbaŋa ma methɨ muna i laghɨye moli, kaero i giyava waenɨma ma modae laghɨye. Ko iyemaeŋge mo vikikighathɨgha waen thovuye moli ghaghada mbaŋake iyake.”
Jisas va i vakathakai vara vakathake ghamba rotaele iyake Kena Galili e tɨne. Le vakathako ghamba rotaele iyako i woraŋgiya le vwenyevwenye na gharaghambu thɨ loŋweghathɨ.
Thaga e ghereiye, kaero Jisas weiyaŋgiya tɨnae, oghaghae na gharaghambu thɨ raka e ghemba Kapenaom, na mbowo vethɨ yaku gheko mbaŋa vavana.
Jisas i ru e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne
Thaga Valaŋani ghambaŋa ma vama bwagabwaga, Jisas i voro Jerusalem.
E Ŋgolo Boboma ghayayao tɨne i vaidiŋgiya gharɨgharɨ vavana thɨ vakuneŋaŋgiya lenji burumwaka, sip na bunebune na vavana thiya yaku e lenji tebol na thɨ tenɨto yao.
Jisas i tarailaila yao gharaten lenji mani na i mwanavevewoŋgiya lenji tebol. I mbana thiyothiyo vavana na i vakatha gheyabɨyabɨbɨwe, na i vagege raŋgiyaŋgiwe, weinjiyaŋgiya lenji sip na burumwaka.
I dage weŋgiya va thɨ vakuneŋaŋgiya bunebuneko iŋa, “Hu bigiraŋgiya bigibigike thiyake eto. Tha hu vakatha Bwebwe le ŋgolo na ŋgoreiya ghamba maket.”
Gharaghambuko thɨ renuwaŋakikiya buk le utu iŋa, “Len ŋgolo ghagharethovu i ra e ghareŋguke ŋgoreiya ndɨghe.”
Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Thambovakatha ghamba rotaele ne u vakatha na i vaghareime e len rɨghe na u vakatha iyake?”
Jisas i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Hu rakayathu Ŋgolo Bobomake iyake na mbaŋa thegheto eŋge e tɨne kaero ya vatadɨvaova.”
Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Ŋgolo Bobomake iyake va i wo theghathegha ghwevarɨ na umbowona amba thɨ vatadɨvao, na mbene mbaŋa thegheto eŋge kaero u vatadɨvaova?”
Ko ŋgolo bobomako va i utuutu kaiwaeko amalaghɨniye riwae mbe utuniye.
Mbaŋa vama ve thuweiruva na e ghereiye ambama gharaghambu thɨ renuwaŋakikiya ghalɨŋaeke iyake na thɨ loŋweghathɨgha buk le utu na utuutu Jisas va i utuŋaŋgi.
Mbaŋa vamba ina Jerusalem Thaga Valaŋani kaiwae, gharɨgharɨ lemoyo va thɨ thuwe le vakathaŋgiko ghamba rotaele na thɨ loŋweghathɨgha amalaghɨniye.
Ko iyemaeŋge Jisas mava le renuwaŋako i wa weŋgi na i vareminjeŋgi, kaiwae va i ghareghare gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye lenji renuwaŋa.
Le ghareghareko ma i tubo na valɨkaiwae lolo regha i utugiyawe gharɨgharɨ lenji renuwaŋa kaiwae, ko kaiwae vama i ghareghare budakai ina gharɨgharɨ e gharenji.
